title: 第五章玩弄人心高家此子太狠了第六章定国公懵了这是我孙子
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 此言一出，崔星河脸色狂变。
以荒山内有金子诱骗满村老小连夜挖山开荒也就算了。
这金子还能外面是金，里面是铜，人竟能如此歹毒？！
他嘴角抽搐的看向高阳，内心狂颤。
龙椅上，女帝武曌也满脸动容，震惊不已。
“外面是金，里面是铜，够狠。”
高阳闲庭信步的走在金銮殿上，如履平地。
这自信张扬的模样，十分放肆，但此刻，却无一人开口呵斥。
高阳脸上带着淡淡笑容，“只要有县令配合，完全可以当场剪开还回来的金子，再倒打一耙，当庭上刑。”
“普通村民哪能抗住严苛的刑罚。”
“只需几个大刑，这些挖出金子的村民便会被屈打成招，这个时候，哪怕他们明白这一切，也晚了。”
“没有银子偿还，他们就只能签下卖身契，终身为茶奴。”
“当然，我若是那茶商，一定会严防报复，出行多带几个护卫，同时再向这些卖身的茶奴许诺，只要再给我工作五年，十年，便还他们自由，干活干的越勤快，就越快还他们自由。”
“等赚了钱，生意越做越大以后，为了方便运茶，还可以修个路，修个桥，当然，对外则是宣称方便村民出行，在当地还能收获一个大善人的名声。”
此言一出。
金銮殿内，落针可闻。
文武百官齐齐的盯着高阳，嘴唇嗡动。
他们的心中，掀起一阵滔天骇浪。
哪怕是女帝的手，也情不自禁的攥紧龙椅，目光直勾勾的盯着高阳。
这个答案，纵然是她这个出题人，也被震惊。
在她所想，此题就是考验反应速度以及对人性的掌控。
天下乱象盘踞已久，常规手段难以根除。
非常之时，当用非常之人，非常规之手段！
唯有利用人性之恶，才能治国安邦平天下，成为她武曌的治世能臣！
这题，考的就是对人性的掌控，一味的提高工钱，注定是下乘手段。
荒山埋金，或者以谣言等手段，她也想过。
在她心里，这就是完美的答案。
但她没想到，高阳还有后续手段，穷山僻壤，先贿赂县令。
再以铜为金，进行诬告，严刑逼供，让挖金的百姓成为茶奴。
并且这厮想的还很周全，给予期限，令这些卖身为奴的百姓有个盼头，不至于鱼死网破。
一个极为肮脏的局，到了最后，他高阳居然还成了当地的大善人！
高阳，给她交出了一份满意答案。
此子，纵然不入朝为官，也绝不能让他从商！
女帝心里下了决定，他若从商，不知多少百姓会被玩死！
崔星河目瞪口呆，不敢置信。
他没想到，高阳竟这么快就给出了答卷。
他开始思索着此事的可行性。
但他越想就越是心惊。
高峰也难以置信的回头，盯着高阳，内心狂颤。
这般阴险狡诈之辈，真是他高家百年将门的后代？
这等计谋，莫说是金銮殿上的其他臣子，哪怕是他这个当爹的都有些害怕。
高阳目光落在武曌的身上，有些可惜的道，“陛下，时间太紧，此局还有一些漏洞，要是能再给草民一些时间，此局会更完美。”
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, Cui Xinghe's face changed wildly.
Just pretend that there is gold in the barren mountains and trick the whole village into digging the mountains overnight to clear up wasteland.
How can this gold be gold on the outside and copper on the inside? How can people be so vicious? !
The corner of his mouth twitched as he looked at Gao Yang, his heart trembling wildly.
Sitting on the dragon throne, Empress Wu Zhao also had a face full of emotion and shock.
"It's gold on the outside and copper on the inside. It's cruel enough."
Gao Yang walked leisurely on the Jinluan Hall, as if he were walking on flat ground.
This confident and flamboyant look was very unrestrained, but at this moment, no one spoke up to scold him.
Gao Yang had a faint smile on his face, "As long as the county magistrate cooperates, the gold returned can be cut open on the spot, raked over, and sentenced to death in court."
"How can ordinary villagers withstand harsh punishments?"
"With just a few severe punishments, these villagers who dug up the gold will be beaten into submission. At this time, even if they understand all this, it will be too late."
"Without money to repay, they can only sign a contract of sale and become tea slaves for life."
"Of course, if I were that tea merchant, I would definitely guard against retaliation and bring more guards with me when traveling. At the same time, I would promise these prostituted tea slaves that as long as they work for me for another five or ten years, I will give them their freedom. The harder they work, the faster they will be given their freedom."
"When you make money and the business grows bigger, you can build a road or a bridge to facilitate the transportation of tea. Of course, externally it will be claimed to be convenient for villagers to travel, and you can also gain a reputation as a good person in the local area."
As soon as this statement came out.
In the Jinluan Hall, you can hear a needle drop.
All the civil and military officials stared at Gao Yang, their lips twitching.
There was a huge wave of panic in their hearts.
Even the empress' hand couldn't help but clenched the dragon chair tightly, staring straight at Gao Yang.
Even she, the person who asked the question, was shocked by this answer.
In her opinion, this question is a test of reaction speed and control of human nature.
Chaos has been entrenched in the world for a long time, and conventional means are difficult to eradicate.
In extraordinary times, extraordinary people and extraordinary means should be used!
Only by making use of the evil of human nature can we govern the country and bring peace to the world, and become a capable minister in the world of Wu Zhao!
This question tests the control of human nature. Blindly raising wages is destined to be a inferior method.
She has also thought about burying gold in barren mountains, or using rumors and other means.
In her mind, this was the perfect answer.
But she didn't expect that Gao Yang would have a follow-up method, and bribe the county magistrate first in a remote mountainous area.
Then use copper as gold, make false accusations, torture and extract confessions, and turn the people who dig gold into tea slaves.
Moreover, this fellow was very thoughtful and gave a time limit so that these people who sold themselves into slavery would have hope and would not be in trouble.
It was an extremely dirty game, but in the end, Gao Yang actually became a great philanthropist in the local area!
Gao Yang gave her a satisfactory answer.
Even if this son does not become an official in the court, he will never be allowed to engage in business!
The empress made a decision in her heart. If he went into business, I don't know how many people would be killed!
Cui Xinghe was stunned and couldn't believe it.
He didn't expect that Gao Yang would give the answer so quickly.
He began to think about the feasibility of this matter.
But the more he thought about it, the more frightened he became.
Gao Feng also turned around in disbelief and stared at Gao Yang, his heart trembling wildly.
Is such a sinister and cunning person really the descendant of his century-old general of the Gao family?
Not to mention the other ministers in the Jinluan Palace, even he, the father, was a little scared of such a plan.
Gao Yang's eyes fell on Wu Zhao, and he said with some pity, "Your Majesty, time is too tight, there are still some loopholes in this game. If the grassroots can be given some more time, this game will be more perfect."
title_en: Chapter 5: Playing with people's hearts. This son of the Gao family is too cruel. Chapter 6: Duke Dingguo is confused. This is my grandson.
